description: Save one checklist's playlist after the server checks it. lines is the ordered list of the playlist's lines. The server checks that line_ids are unique and order runs 1, 2, 3 without gaps; that the credits of every line except option_list and note add up to the published credits (within the range, where a range is published); that every slot's fills_from names an option_list and every option_list is named by a slot; that every course code is one of the school's learning units; that every area designation is in the school policy; that choose has n no greater than its courses; that every quote appears verbatim in the requirements section or a linked section; and that every course code in the requirements text appears in a line or in a note line that names it. It never alters the lines. It returns playlist_id, status, and every error in plain words, each naming its line: lines with errors are saved as rejected, so correct them and save again.

built_by.description: Who built this playlist: a short string naming the agent and model. Stored with the saved playlist. A save without it is rejected.

courses.description: Course codes, for course, one_of, choose and option_list; otherwise empty

credits.description: A number; null only for option_list and note

designation.description: area only: the designation exactly as in the school policy

fills_from.description: slot only: the line_id of an option_list

heading.description: The group heading the line sits under on the page, as printed

kind.description: course: one required course. one_of: one course from a short list printed on the line. choose: n courses or credits from courses printed together. slot: filled from an option list elsewhere on the page. option_list: a list that feeds slots and never adds to the total by itself. area: any course carrying a designation from the school policy. open: any course that earns credit. note: a printed condition that is not itself credit.

source.description: Where the school published it: the capture, named as the manifest names it, and a verbatim passage of 300 characters or fewer from that capture's cleaned text

text.description: One plain sentence a person could follow
examples: Take one BUS/DPR elective from the list below.
